product_metadata.title: Coffee Scoop: U-Taste Durable 18/8 Stainless Steel Measuring Coffee Scoop 1 tablespoon & 2 tablespoon
features: [Not just make it, we upgrade it!] We are a professional kitchenware producer who have been focused on customer experience. In order to offer better and eco-friendly kitchenware, U-Taste collects customer reviews of all similar products on Amazon. And then upgrade the products based on the data of the bad evaluation with the aim to provide customers with more perfect kitchenware products.

[Food grade 18/8 stainless steel] If you are tired of flimsy plastic scoops and rust easily 201 stainless steel as 47.95% reviews encountered, 18/8 stainless steel is a great replacement. It is anti-rust and will not absorb the smell of coffee like your plastic spoons do. It has relatively heavier weight with smooth edges and a nice finish, easy to hold and grab.

[Short enough to fit in your coffee canister] 24.85% reviews are worried about the handle bending and losing its shape. We thickened the handle to avoid bending. The scoop is short enough to fit into your canisters, big enough to stay on top of the coffee beans. Integrated, no solder joints. It has a slight thumb indentation that makes it easy to grab.

[Dishwasher safe with no troubles] This spoon is dishwasher safe. Never rust or deform. Do not need great patience if you hand wash it. It's not a deep bowl, so it's easy to clean and rinse, and easy to dip into bags. A handy compact size so you can store them easily. Just nest them in your drawer or store into the canister. These 2 features meet 24.27% reviews' expectation.

[With US & metric measurement engraved on handle] Spoon crafted with smooth engravings on handle is worth a try, if you don't want painted measurement. Easy to read. You’ll never have to worry about the numbers washing or wearing off. Scoop coffee beans directly out of coffee container and make a cup of morning coffee for yourself!
